title: Add direct MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge coverage
description:
## Summary

Add focused runtime tests for the morphology-to-influence-radius bridge used by implicit welded-surface skinning.

## User Mandate

> "Review this external audit + follow up delta audit and synthesize to durable tasks"

STRICT. This task is created only as the durable owner for the confirmed audit mechanism. Preserve the supplied audit provenance and keep the change limited to direct bridge coverage.

## Scope

- Add `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridgeTests.cs` in the runtime test assembly.
- Cover missing Body or limb data, non-finite and non-positive authored radii, deterministic fallback radius, and clamped midpoint thickness sampling.
- Preserve the existing bridge contract and the pure weight-authoring core.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Each fallback and midpoint-clamping branch has a direct assertion.
- Tests prove the bridge uses resolved morphology when valid data exists and the documented fallback otherwise.
- Existing skinned renderer and influence-radius tests remain green.

## Validation

Run focused runtime tests for `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge`, runtime and runtime-test builds, and `git diff --check`. Unity execution is required before status changes to Done.

## Findings

Confirmed low-severity test-ownership gap from both supplied animation audits and current source. The bridge is currently exercised transitively through `CreatureSkinnedMeshRendererTests`; no dedicated test file exists.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Add direct branch coverage without changing runtime behavior.

comments.body:
Round 4 sequential review evidence (2026-09-07): Added direct runtime fixture Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridgeTests.cs. Production bridge logic was not edited by this review; the pre-existing staged bridge diff only replaces partial CreaturePart construction with the authoritative string-id resolver overload. Direct tests cover: valid resolved body radius 0.85 and limb midpoint 0.10; unavailable morphology via empty Body plus generic attachment fallback 0.5; non-positive body radius 0 fallback 0.5; degenerate first limb segment midpoint clamped at lower bound (0.2) plus normal second-segment midpoint interpolation (0.6). Tests assert repeated deterministic arrays and finite values.

Validation: dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore => exit 0. dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore => initially failed only because fixture used nonexistent PartType.Shape; corrected to PartType.Part; rerun exit 0. dotnet test ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore --no-build --verbosity minimal => exit 0, but this project command does not provide Unity Test Framework execution evidence. Unity MCP read_console => no Unity Editor instances found; focused PlayMode run could not initialize (bridge unavailable). Therefore Unity-required acceptance gate remains blocked and task must not be marked Done.

Scope review: no extraction, skeleton contract, benchmark, or GeneratedCreature files changed by this review. Repository git diff --check is affected by pre-existing unrelated Assets/Test.unity trailing whitespace; focused source/test build is clean. Residual risk: Unity PlayMode must still run the new fixture and existing CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer tests, and exact runtime branch execution cannot be claimed until a Unity 6000.0.35f1 editor is connected. Next step: connect Unity, inspect console/compilation, run focused PlayMode tests, then rerun the existing skinned renderer/influence tests and update task status only with that evidence.
